Vs. The State of Maharashtra ] ... ... Mr. Marnik Shah i/b Mr. Kushal Mor for the applicant. Ms. A.A. Takalkar, A.P.P. for the State. Mr. K.N. Wagh, Api attached to Kongao Police Station, Bhiwandi, Thane is present in the court. ... Coram : Smt. Bharati Dangre, J. Dated : 04Th July, 2022. P.C.:- 1. The applicant though not named in the Fir, seek protection from his arrest in C.R. No.I-145 of 2022 r with Kongao Police Station, Bhiwandi, which invokes S 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Ipc and Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e) and 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety Standards Ac Javeed Salahuddin Khan vs State Of Maharashtra on 4 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149026497/ 1 2.
texts.facts: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that AJN 2/3 31 ABA-1765.22.odt has surfaced from the statement of co-accused, who has alleged that he was introduced to one Mustihar, who offered him to run his paan shop styled as Mustihar Paan Shop. When a raid was conducted in the paan shop, goods worth Rs.2,490/- came to be seized, which is the prohibited substance not permitted to be sold/purchased in the State of Maharashtra in terms of the directions issued by the Commissioner, Konkan Division. The co-accused in his statement led the investigation to the present applicant, as according to him, the present applicant is the supplier of prohibited substance to his paan shop. 3. From the FIR, it can be seen that on the very same day, the Food Safety Officer conducted raids on various paan kiosks and seized the prohibited substance. However, as far as the induction of the present applicant is concerned, it is only at the instance of the person, who is running the Mustihar Paan Shop. However, since the statement of co-accused is to the effect that the product was sold to him by the applicant, he must report to the police station and co-operate in investigation. Since the substance recovered is only for a minimal amount of Rs.2,490/-, the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not warranted.
